name: binhex-trimarr
description: Removes (trims) unwanted audio and subtitles from matroska container format video files using mkvmerge. Features recursive scanning, smart skip via SQLite tracking, commentary track safety, multi-language support, auto-managed mkvmerge binary, and space savings reporting. Supports one-shot or cron-scheduled operation.

paths.name: Path: /config
paths.description: Container path for configuration files, database (trimarr.db), and logs.

paths.name: Path: /media
paths.description: Container path to your media files (e.g. movies, tv). Matches the default TRIMARR_MEDIA_PATH.

variables.name: Variable: TRIMARR_LANGUAGE
variables.description: (Required) ISO 639-2 language code(s) for tracks to keep. Comma-separate multiple codes, e.g. 'eng' or 'eng,fre'. See https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_ISO_639-2_codes

variables.name: Variable: TRIMARR_MEDIA_PATH
variables.description: Directories containing media files to process. Use pipe (|) as separator for multiple paths, e.g. /media/Movies|/media/TV

variables.name: Variable: TRIMARR_SCHEDULE
variables.description: Cron schedule for repeated runs, e.g. '0 2 * * *' (daily at 2am), '@daily', '*/30 * * * *'. Omit for one-shot mode (container exits after processing).

variables.name: Variable: TRIMARR_EDIT_METADATA_TITLE
variables.description: If set to 'yes', each file's title metadata is updated to match its filename.

variables.name: Variable: TRIMARR_DELETE_METADATA_TITLE
variables.description: If set to 'yes', title metadata is deleted from files. Mutually exclusive with TRIMARR_EDIT_METADATA_TITLE.

variables.name: Variable: TRIMARR_KEEP_SUBTITLES
variables.description: If set to 'yes', all subtitle tracks are kept regardless of language.

variables.name: Variable: TRIMARR_KEEP_AUDIO
variables.description: If set to 'yes', all audio tracks are kept regardless of language.

variables.name: Variable: TRIMARR_KEEP_NATIVE_AUDIO
variables.description: If set to 'yes', audio tracks matching the film's original language (detected via IMDb/TMDb) are kept even if they don't match TRIMARR_LANGUAGE. Useful for dubbed films.

variables.name: Variable: TRIMARR_NO_BACKUP
variables.description: If set to 'yes', original files are deleted instead of renamed to .bak after successful processing.

variables.name: Variable: TRIMARR_DRY_RUN
variables.description: If set to 'yes', performs a dry run without modifying any files. Defaults to 'yes' for safety — set to 'no' to allow actual processing.

variables.name: Variable: TRIMARR_STRIP_LOWER_CHANNELS
variables.description: If set to 'yes', audio tracks with channel count below the maximum surviving track are removed (e.g. drops 2ch if 8ch exists).

variables.name: Variable: TRIMARR_STRIP_COMMENTARY
variables.description: If set to 'yes', audio and subtitle tracks whose name contains 'commentary' (case-insensitive) are removed.

variables.name: Variable: TRIMARR_STRIP_SUBTITLE_REGEX
variables.description: Python regex pattern. Any subtitle track whose name matches is removed after language filtering, regardless of language. Uses Python re syntax. Example: '(?i)songs.*signs'

variables.name: Variable: TRIMARR_RUN_ON_START
variables.description: If set to 'yes', fires one run immediately on startup before the first scheduled cron fire. Requires TRIMARR_SCHEDULE to be set.

variables.name: Variable: TRIMARR_TMDB_API_KEY
variables.description: Optional TMDb API key. Used as a fallback when IMDb identification fails. Get a free key at https://www.themoviedb.org/settings/api

variables.name: Variable: TRIMARR_TVDB_API_KEY
variables.description: Optional TVDB API key. Used as a fallback when IMDb and TMDb identification fails. Useful for TV shows whose NFO files contain only a TVDB ID. Get a free key at https://thetvdb.com/api

variables.name: Variable: TRIMARR_KEEP_UNDEFINED_AUDIO
variables.description: If set to 'yes', audio tracks with an undefined language code ('und') are kept rather than dropped by the language filter. Useful when source files have missing or incorrect language tags.

variables.name: Variable: TRIMARR_LOG_LEVEL
variables.description: Logging level. Dropdown shows valid choices; INFO is default.

variables.name: Variable: TRIMARR_DATABASE_PATH
variables.description: Path to SQLite database for tracking processed files.

variables.name: Variable: TRIMARR_LOG_PATH
variables.description: Path to log file for tracking application events.

variables.name: Variable: TRIMARR_MKVMERGE_PATH
variables.description: Path to mkvmerge executable. When omitted, trimarr manages its own binary (auto-downloaded and updated).

variables.name: Variable: TRIMARR_PRE_PROCESS
variables.description: Shell command to run before processing a directory. Use {leaf} for basename, {dir} for full path. Example: 'no_ransom.sh --unlock yes {leaf}'

variables.name: Variable: TRIMARR_POST_PROCESS
variables.description: Shell command to run after processing a directory. Use {leaf} for basename, {dir} for full path. Example: 'no_ransom.sh --unlock no {leaf}'

variables.name: Variable: TRIMARR_COMMAND_TIMEOUT_MINS
variables.description: Timeout in minutes for each pre/post process command. Set to 0 to disable timeout.

variables.name: Variable: TRIMARR_NO_UPDATE_CHECK
variables.description: If set to 'yes', skips the automatic check for a newer mkvmerge version.

variables.name: Variable: TRIMARR_SKIP_SIZE_CHECK
variables.description: If set to 'yes', bypasses the 50% output size guard. Use when legitimate remuxes produce significantly smaller files.

variables.name: Variable: ENABLE_STARTUP_SCRIPTS
variables.description: Specify whether to run startup scripts to install and/or configure additional applications.

variables.name: Variable: ENABLE_HEALTHCHECK
variables.description: Enable or disable healthchecks.

variables.name: Variable: HEALTHCHECK_COMMAND
variables.description: The command or script to execute, if not specified then the script healthcheck.sh will be used (process, dns and https checking).

variables.name: Variable: HEALTHCHECK_ACTION
variables.description: The action to execute if the healthcheck command returns a non zero exit code, if not specified the action will be 'exit 1', if you want the container to exit on failure then set the action to 'kill 1'.

variables.name: Variable: HEALTHCHECK_HOSTNAME
variables.description: The hostname used when performing HTTPS and DNS healthchecking.

variables.name: Variable: PUID
variables.description: User ID for the running container

variables.name: Variable: PGID
variables.description: Group ID for the running container

variables.name: Variable: UMASK
variables.description: UMASK for the running container
